async def act(page):
    # Search for any link or button with 'next' in its name (case-insensitive)
    # First, try links
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    for i in range(link_count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        name = await link.get_attribute("aria-label") or await link.text_content()
        if name and "next" in name.lower():
            await link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            new_url = page.url
            return new_url
    # If no link found, try buttons
    all_buttons = page.get_by_role("button")
    button_count = await all_buttons.count()
    for i in range(button_count):
        button = all_buttons.nth(i)
        name = await button.get_attribute("aria-label") or await button.text_content()
        if name and "next" in name.lower():
            await button.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            new_url = page.url
            return new_url
    # If still not found, search within navigation elements
    nav_elements = page.get_by_role("navigation")
    nav_count = await nav_elements.count()
    for i in range(nav_count):
        nav = nav_elements.nth(i)
        next_in_nav = nav.get_by_role("link", name="Next Post")
        count = await next_in_nav.count()
        if count > 0:
            await next_in_nav.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            new_url = page.url
            return new_url
    # As a last resort, use explore_page_and_links to find linked pages and check for 'Next Post' in titles
    # But this might navigate away and not directly click 'Next Post', so it's not ideal.
    # Since task is guaranteed, return an error if nothing found.
    return "Next Post link not found after thorough search."
